name: Landbright · Onboard a new person
description: On identity.created from Landbright (a person added by an administrator or an HR source): read the person, set their birthright groups (everyone's, and their department's), ask them to set up a second step and accept the terms at their first sign-in, and send a welcome email. On identity.updated with a new department (a mover): set their birthright groups again, so they leave the old department's and join the new one's. Birthright memberships have source hr; memberships given by hand or by a grant are left alone. The flow never touches Landbright's administrators.

parameters.body: {{ JSON.stringify({ From: { Email: 'landflow@landflow.test', Name: 'Landflow' }, To: [{ Email: $json.to, Name: $json.toName }], Subject: $json.subject, Text: $json.text }) }}
